tha-ap49:1.1: Sayanadāyaka.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato mettacittassa tādino / sayanaggaṃ mayā dinnaṃ dussabhaṇḍehi atthataṃ. // //
tha-ap49:2.1: Paṭiggahesi bhagavā kappiyaṃ sayanāsanaṃ / uṭṭhāya āsanā tamhā vehāsaṃ uggamī jino. // //
tha-ap49:3.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ sayanam adāsi 'haṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi sayanassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap49:4.1: Ekapaññās' ito kappe Varuṇo Devasavhayo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap49:5.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap49:6.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sayanadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
